annualRides.label: Annual rides

source.locator: measure_name = "TTC Annual Passenger Rides Peak (000s)" and "TTC Annual Passenger Rides Non-Peak (000s)"; origin as stated in the file: Source: Toronto Transit Commission
source.method: Peak + non-peak for each year, × 1,000 (the file states both in thousands).

annualRides.note: The file's definitions: peak is the weekday a.m. rush (start of service to 08:59) and p.m. rush (15:00–18:59); off-peak is weekdays 09:00–14:59 and 19:00 to end of service, plus weekends and holidays.

source.locator: measure_name = "TTC Annual Passenger Rides Peak (000s)"; origin as stated in the file: Source: Toronto Transit Commission
source.method: Values as published, one per period. Multiplied by 1,000 (the measure is stated in thousands).

source.locator: measure_name = "TTC Annual Passenger Rides Non-Peak (000s)"; origin as stated in the file: Source: Toronto Transit Commission
source.method: Values as published, one per period. Multiplied by 1,000 (the measure is stated in thousands).

monthlyRidership.label: Monthly ridership

source.locator: measure_name = "TTC Monthly Ridership"; origin as stated in the file: Source: Toronto Transit Commission (TTC).Please note that January and December figures may consist of data from an additional partial week.
source.method: Values as published, one per period.

monthlyRidership.note: The TTC notes that January and December figures may include an extra partial week.

source.locator: measure_name = "TTC Average Weekday Ridership"; origin as stated in the file: Source: Toronto Transit Commission (TTC)
source.method: Values as published, one per period.

source.locator: measure_name = "TTC Ridership Revenues"; origin as stated in the file: Source: Toronto Transit Commission (TTC). Please note that January and December figures may consist of data from an additional partial week.
source.method: Sum of the monthly values for each calendar year. Past years missing any period are left out.
